business_problem: Bradesco wanted to move beyond an early AI assistant and scale generative AI across the bank, but it needed a shared technical foundation, trained teams, and production use cases that could improve both employee and customer experiences quickly.
solution_summary: Bradesco used Bain support to turn an internal chatbot upgrade into a broader generative AI rollout. The bank first improved its branch manager chatbot in 12 weeks, then used that success to stand up its first LLM-agnostic generative AI platform so future applications could scale without locking the bank to one model. On top of that platform, Bradesco built three major experiences: a customer chatbot that answers questions and resolves issues for millions of customers, a call center chatbot that assists service agents during support interactions, and Smart payments, an agentic payment experience delivered through WhatsApp. The bank paired the shared platform with cross-functional training across technical, business, and customer-experience teams. The source does not name a separate storage tier, but it clearly describes a reusable platform layer that routes customer queries, market context, and payment requests into customer-facing and agent-assist workflows.

data_flow: Bradesco routes internal branch-manager questions, customer requests, and payment intents into a shared generative AI platform. That platform feeds the customer chatbot, the call center chatbot, and the Smart payments experience on WhatsApp, while trained business and technical teams refine the apps and support production rollout.
business_outcome: Bradesco used the shared platform to launch customer-facing and agent-assist tools quickly, achieving strong chatbot retention and response accuracy while reducing call handling time and expanding generative AI across the bank.
